## Concern

Describe the file, note, tool output, or contribution that may cross the repository boundary.

## Location

Link the file, pull request, issue, or commit.

## Why It May Be Unsafe

Explain whether it may include ISO contents, extracted files, executable binaries, copied proprietary source, copyrighted assets, or other restricted material.

## Suggested Resolution

Describe whether the content should be removed, replaced with metadata, rewritten as original notes, or reviewed further.
